scope: Isolated Edge; synthetic API profiles, localhost model discovery and translation. No real user credentials or provider access.

results.name: No page switches APIs; configured manual model is retained before discovery
Explicit discovery persists only sanitized model metadata and populates all reading surfaces
Popup switches only the model, synchronizes reader/research and updates active saved default
Reader model selector controls actual document body translation
Research selector uses the same API for questions and rejects legacy alternate-profile routing
API mutation outside Settings and selecting an unlisted model are rejected without changing state
A model selection awaiting commit prevents a new document request with the previous model
A model change in another window cancels a pending document request without mixing answers
A stale settings tab cannot overwrite a model selection made during reading
Discovering an unsaved alternate API stores a separate catalog without changing the active connection
Only settings switches APIs; stale model selections cannot cross the new connection
Changing credentials or custom headers invalidates the visible catalog; returning restores its own list
Upstream failure preserves a previously read catalog and saved active model
Reopening readers restores cached models without fetching upstream or applying a model
Traditional active APIs hide unrelated AI models while preserving ordinary document use
Catalog storage is bounded by bytes and connection count; cancelled discovery cannot overwrite it
Compact model selectors render without horizontal overflow or uncaught errors
